name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the skill or its safety model
title: "[idea] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**The problem**
What gap or friction are you hitting when closing a session.

**Your idea**
What you would like the skill to do.

**Safety first**
This skill guards a non-git vault: read-before-write, .bak backup, idempotent append, mtime guard, atomic write. If your idea changes a write path, explain how it stays safe to run twice.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything you already tried or ruled out.
